name: ssh.run
description: Run a command on a remote Linux server over SSH. Uses key auth by default so it never asks for a password in chat unless authMethod is explicitly set to password. Set sudo:true to run the command with elevated privileges — the sudo password is collected through a secure user-only prompt (never sent to the model) and can be remembered per host, mirroring elevated.run.

command.description: Command to run on the remote host

authMethod.description: Authentication method. Defaults to key. Password uses a user-only secret prompt.

strictHostKeyChecking.description: Whether OpenSSH should enforce known_hosts checking, default true

sudo.description: Run the command with sudo on the remote host. The sudo password is requested through a secure user-only prompt (never sent to the model) and is remembered per host for the session.

sudoUser.description: Optional target user for sudo (sudo -u). Defaults to root.

name: ssh.session.start
description: Start a persistent SSH PTY session to a remote Linux server. Uses key auth by default so it never asks for a password in chat unless authMethod is explicitly set to password.

authMethod.description: Authentication method. Defaults to key. Password uses a user-only secret prompt.

strictHostKeyChecking.description: Whether OpenSSH should enforce known_hosts checking, default true

name: ssh.session.run
description: Run a command inside an existing persistent SSH PTY session created by ssh.session.start. Shell state such as cwd and environment is preserved between calls.

sshSessionId.description: SSH session ID returned by ssh.session.start

command.description: Command to run in the remote SSH shell

name: ssh.session.close
description: Close a persistent SSH PTY session created by ssh.session.start.

sshSessionId.description: SSH session ID returned by ssh.session.start
